sentences.text: Rajrani vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023

Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh
Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 6466 of 2020
Applicant :- Rajrani

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Hanuman Prasad Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as the learned Aga and perused the
record.

2. The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in
Case Crime No.368 of 2020, under Sections 420, 467, 478 and 471 Ipc, Police Station Maudarwaja,
District Farrukhabad.
3.  An F.I.R. dated 27.8.2020 was lodged by one Ravikant, who is a Government Official alleging that certain consolidation records were prepared in a clandestine manner.
The F.I.R. was lodged against three persons, namely, Ram Shankar, Rajrani and Ramkali.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that the accused-applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in the offence.

He further submits that the F.I.R. in question was Rajrani vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169335889/
1 registered on 27.8.2020, but till date police has not collected any such information on the basis of which complicity of present accused-applicant can be said to be established in above mentioned case crime number.

He further submits that this Court after considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, granted interim protection to the accused-applicant on 5.10.2020 and she has cooperated during the course of investigation and she has not misused the liberty granted to her and, therefore, the accused-applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail, but not disputed the aforesaid facts.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds that the accused-applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly, anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Rao/-
